visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A montage of photos shows a couple at various stages of their relationship: ten years ago, five years ago at their wedding, two years ago with an ultrasound, and currently with their child. The lighting transitions through various natural and indoor settings. (2) The couple is seen in a brightly lit restaurant with wooden furniture, giving thumbs-up gestures to the camera. The woman wears a blue dress with a bow, and the man is in a casual white t-shirt. (3) The man, wearing sunglasses and a beige jacket, carries a toddler through a busy shopping mall with retail storefronts visible in the background. (4) Inside a modern home, the woman plays with her child while wearing a cartoon mask, followed by a close-up of the father using a nasal aspirator on the child. (5) The family plays with a blue plastic toy train set on a play mat in a well-lit living room. (6) The man walks through a white noren curtain into a Teppanyaki restaurant. (7) Outside a building, the couple waves cheerfully at the camera; the woman is in a blue dress and the man wears glasses. (8) A chef in a white uniform prepares steak on a flat grill, creating a large burst of fire. High-quality raw beef and a large wooden pepper grinder are showcased. (9) The couple is shown eating and reacting with joy to the food. (10) Close-up shots show a pair of black socks and a plastic wrapper discarded on a wooden floor. (11) A screen capture of a digital article titled about husbands changing after kids is displayed. (12) The video concludes with the family seated in an airplane cabin, with the child smiling and holding a toy phone.

[Subtitle]: 「我去躺一下」直接躺到過年、上廁所時間無敵久！「老公變成爸爸後」的5種奇怪轉變. [Logo]: 妞新聞. [Subtitle]: 放假就肚子痛去廁所的日常了. (12) [Subtitle]: 你也要繼續包容我喔 這十年謝謝你啦.
